verdict.rationale: Incremental rollout is a fair question for a PaaS like Fly.io, but nothing in the evidence documents rolling, canary or blue-green deploy strategies. Per-Machine lifecycle control and placement via the Machines API (fly-io-docs-43) is a developer building block, not a rollout feature. Sprite checkpoint rollback (fly-io-docs-9) is a different capability. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius
